But maybe they want the population of New York state? The question says "紐約現在的人口是多少？" It could refer to New York City or New York State. Usually when someone says "New York" it might mean the city. But ambiguous. We can clarify. But the instruction says: "If you do not have enough information to answer the question, ask clarifying questions."
